rationale: The agent executed write actions without clear user confirmation: it modified a pending order item and updated the user address directly. There’s no evidence it confirmed the substitution to the “easiest” jigsaw before proceeding, nor that it verified or corrected shipping addresses on existing orders as requested (only the user profile address was modified). Authentication is unclear beyond a name/ZIP lookup, and the final message provides no confirmation details or outcomes. The user’s instruction to mention the two problems together in the same order was not followed. Therefore it did not complete the request in line with policy.
